objective: Make ChatGPT the sole intended interactive System controller, keep Neon/PostgreSQL system_events as the single mutable derived-game-state owner, retire LifeUp from the target runtime architecture without deleting its legacy code/history, and make every Ron OS recovery path route consistently to the cloud-first core.

roles_before.artifact: Ron OS + claim-specific live owners own underlying real-world truth and execution.
Neon/PostgreSQL system_events is the one mutable owner of derived System state.
ChatGPT can reason over Ron OS/live owners and write through the shared PostgreSQL action gate, but recovery documents still conflict with the cloud-first architecture.
Northflank PWA reads the same event-derived snapshot.
LifeUp bridge/MCP/Tailscale code remains available as optional downstream prototype while stale routing and its old regression guard still describe it as primary/live System implementation.
PROTOCOL.md exact live-mutation permission rules remain authoritative.
Git history, architecture manifests and legacy bridge code preserve previous architecture and rollback evidence.

role_dispositions.destination: Ron OS and claim-specific live owners continue to own real-world facts; the game layer remains derived only.
Neon/PostgreSQL system_events remains the sole mutable derived-state owner.
ChatGPT becomes the sole intended interactive System controller: natural-language input -> authoritative owner recovery -> System decision -> system_apply_action -> read-back.
Northflank PWA remains a projection over the same cloud core and never becomes another mutable owner.

LifeUp is removed from target runtime routing and retained only as legacy/rollback implementation evidence under system/lifeup/northflank and Git history. Its regression now verifies physical recoverability, auth/secret safety and explicit non-primary status; readiness no longer depends on it.
Existing explicit-permission rules remain unchanged for persistent/live mutations.
Legacy LifeUp code is not deleted; Git history/manifests preserve the old route and deliberate rollback path.

capability_probes.assertion: A fresh Ron OS recovery for System work routes mutable derived state to Neon system_events and never treats LifeUp/MCP as the primary System owner/executor.
Authorized ChatGPT System mutations still route through system_apply_action and remain idempotent/event-sourced.
Nutrition, training, health, finance, schedule, learning and other real-world owners remain authoritative and are not replaced by System state.
Existing LifeUp bridge code still builds/boots behind auth and remains present as legacy evidence even though runtime routing no longer depends on it.

tests.expected: PASS: CURRENT.md, domain-routing and System skills consistently name Neon system_events + ChatGPT controller and do not route primary execution to LifeUp.

tests.command: python tests/lifeup_system_guard.py plus legacy Docker build/start/auth smoke
tests.expected: PASS: old bridge remains recoverable and secret-safe while current routing explicitly marks it retired/legacy.

tests.command: system-cloud-ci (model tests, real PostgreSQL action-gate/HTTP smoke, independent Docker smoke)
tests.expected: PASS without changing production ledger state.

known_intentional_losses: LifeUp is no longer a target runtime dependency or required interactive System surface because Ron chose to operate the System exclusively through ChatGPT.
